Title: EQuestState
Overview: Defines the state of a QuestGraph, QuestBlock, or QuestObjective.
Values: Indicates the graph, block, or objective has not been completed.
Indicates the graph, block, or objective completed with a result of success.
Indicates the graph, block, or objective completed with a result of failed.
Indicates the graph, block, or objective is not one of the other three states, cannot be used, and will not be updated to any other state.
